name: Tale
description: Tale is an MIT-licensed workspace for teams and AI agents. Teams turn projects into tasks with context, owners, and acceptance criteria; configured agents work in persistent sandbox workspaces, and people review reports and deliverables together. It supports repeatable work through project knowledge, skills, and workflows. Free self-hosted software and paid managed deployment are available; agent runtime or model access may have separate costs.
